entry.title: First day of using this blog site

link.title: First day of using this blog site

entry.content:
Hello, Jiahao here, I am currently a Ph.D. candidate in Chemical Biology at MIT, working with Prof. Xiao Wang. My research focuses on computational analysis tool development in spatial biology, trying to decompose and understand the biological variation from different datasets.

I plan to use this site as a place to share research notes, random thoughts, or even personal/fun stuff. I believe writing is a good way to formalize/condense your thoughts into knowledge, and hopefully, I can regain (or even improve) my writing ability in this AI-enriched new world. Let’s see.

Thanks for visiting and have a great day!
entry.summary: A brief introduction about myself and what I plan to share here.
